name: Hotel Plaza e de Russie
insider_take: This Belle Époque gem sits at the heart of Viareggio's legendary promenade, where Puccini once strolled and the world's most extravagant carnival still comes alive each February.
whats_special: Hotel Plaza e de Russie occupies a stunning 1871 palace that has hosted royalty and artists for over 150 years. The hotel's prime location on Viale Regina Margherita offers front-row seats to Viareggio's famous 2-mile stretch of pristine Tuscan coastline, while the town's Art Nouveau architecture creates an open-air museum atmosphere.
pro_tip: Book during late January to early March for Carnevale di Viareggio - Europe's second-largest carnival featuring massive papier-mâché floats that parade right past the hotel's doorstep.
dont_miss: A sunset aperitivo on the hotel's terrace overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea, followed by a evening stroll to nearby Torre del Lago to visit Puccini's villa-museum where he composed La Bohème and Tosca. The surrounding Versilia region offers easy access to Carrara's marble quarries and the medieval hilltop town of Pietrasanta.
pros: Prime beachfront location in Viareggio with direct beach access
Elegant Belle Époque architecture and sophisticated Italian design
Relais & Châteaux luxury standards with exceptional service
Renowned gourmet restaurant featuring Tuscan coastal cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
